description: A white T‑shirt lies on a light wood tabletop, with a red cloth draped in the background. The left hand reaches in and grips the shirt, the right hand joins to lift and open it into a two-hand object, then both hands spread it flat; next the right hand folds one side inward while the left hand holds the fabric steady, and finally both hands fold the shirt again into a smaller, neat rectangle before releasing it.
